evidence_boundaries: The hollow-channel paper reports fully 3D quasi-static PIC evidence only, without experimental or independent-code closure.
The OMEGA EP filament paper directly measures proton radiographs, while the electric-versus-magnetic decomposition and Weibel interpretation are model assisted.
The cnoidal-wave paper reports probe measurements, fits and bicoherence; its local full text is an author preprint and the mechanism is not uniquely identified.

The Orion paper directly observes stochastic magnetic structures and temperature histories, while the whistler attribution and five-to-seven-percent Spitzer conductivity are model-assisted inferences.
The laser-filament wakefield paper directly reports 100-shot energy spectra at 10 Hz and 3 cm; tens-of-kilohertz and long-stage operation are future extrapolations.
No QuickPIC, FBPIC, FLASH, proton-tracking, spectral-fitting or bicoherence computation was performed locally.
